messages:
alice: quick ping — PR #1792 (perf: shard cache keys) is ready for merge but mac builders are stuck in the CI queue. https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1792
ben: can you rebase onto main? last mac flake was fixed with the kernel update.
alice: i did a light rebase earlier, but there's a failing mac e2e in the matrix. can't rerun until a CI slot frees up.
carol: @infra-sre we have spare mac quota on project-redwood-canary — can someone swap buckets or bump quota for a quick rerun? :eyes: 
infra-sre: i can do a temporary quota bump for 10m. ping me the job id.
alice: job id is `job_2023_11_02_5791` — thanks!
ci-bot: Mac-e2e (job_5791) queued on host mac-builder-3, estimated wait ~7m.
ben: if infra-sre can bump, i'll kick the rerun and smoke-check. otherwise we might wait until tonight to avoid deploy freeze.
carol: is there any risk hitting the deploy freeze window? timeline shows freeze starts at 00:00 UTC.
alice: merge is small and low-risk. prefer land today; if we postpone, it becomes a tomorrow priority backlog.
infra-sre: bumped quota for project-redwood-canary for 15m. @ben you should be able to trigger now.
ben: kicked rerun — `gh api -X POST /repos/redwood/repo/actions/runs/5791/dispatches` (checked).
ci-bot: job_5791 rerun started, live logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/5791
ci-bot: job_5791 passed mac-e2e ✅
ben: approved and merged. :tada: thanks everyone for the quick turn.
alice: thanks! will monitor post-merge metrics and open a follow-up if anything odd.
carol: noted — i'll add this to the post-merge checklist.
